source_intake.temporal_skew_assessment: No catastrophic calendar interval hole; every month contained more than 3,000 unique arXiv papers. Ten capped cs.LG month slices and surviving-publisher-index limitations remain the material completeness risks.

annual_phase_candidates.interpretation: CLIP/DALL-E and sparse scaling make multimodal generation and model-scale diversification visible while GPT-3 use begins shifting from model demo to application substrate.
Prompt/Prefix-style adaptation, ZeRO-scale systems, diffusion, LoRA, LaMDA, GPT-J and Copilot preview expose distinct adaptation, systems, dialogue, open-weight and developer-interface layers.
Codex and independent APIs broaden model access while Foundation Models framing, FLAN, TruthfulQA and human-feedback summarization make reuse, steering and evaluation explicit concerns.
T0/verifiers, MT-NLG, API availability, Gopher/GLaM/RETRO/WebGPT and GLIDE/LDM concentrate scale, retrieval, grounding, evaluation/risk and diffusion maturation into a year-end handoff to 2022.

annual_trajectories: adaptation and steering: pretrained models become reusable substrates through parameter-efficient tuning, instruction training and human feedback
scale and systems: sparsity, memory hierarchy, distributed training and retrieval compete with parameter-only scaling
access and distribution: API availability, independent providers and open-weight releases create distinct model-access surfaces
multimodal and generative media: vision-language representation, text-to-image generation and diffusion form separate but interacting branches
developer interfaces: code generation moves from benchmark/model research into integrated programming workflows
dialogue, retrieval and grounding: conversational framing, retrieval augmentation and browsing connect models to external context
evaluation and risk: foundation-model framing, truthfulness evaluation and explicit risk taxonomies become first-class layers
editorial_thesis: 2021年、生成AIはGPT-3後の「巨大な事前学習モデルそのもの」を中心に見る段階から、同じ基盤を再利用・適応・接続する多層システムへ移り始めた。Prefix/Prompt Tuning・LoRA・FLAN/T0・human feedbackはsteering/adaptation layerを、CLIP/DALL-Eからdiffusion/GLIDE/LDMへの連続はmultimodal/generative-media layerを、Codex/Copilotはdeveloper interfaceを、GPT-J/Jurassic/API availabilityはaccess/distribution layerを、Switch/ZeRO/Gopher/GLaM/MT-NLG/RETROはscale/systems/retrieval設計を、TruthfulQA/WebGPT/risk taxonomy/Foundation Models framingはevaluation/grounding/risk layerを形成した。2021年はそれらの層がまだ単一製品へ統合される前、2022年のinstruction-following・reasoning・open distribution・対話製品統合へ橋を架けた年として読む。

residual_claim_boundaries: Vendor, project and author performance/capability/safety evaluations remain attributed rather than treated as independently reproduced results.
Paper publication, first-party announcement, open-weight release, API availability and product preview remain distinct chronology states.
Ten capped cs.LG query slices mean the broad arXiv intake cannot establish historical absence; exact-identity checks protect material selected anchors rather than proving a census.
Current publisher indexes cannot prove that every 2021 first-party page remains linked or byte-identical to its original publication state.
The configured GitHub Release watchlist yielded no normalized 2021 release records; commit-level runtime history is not reconstructed exhaustively.

single_volume_coherence.assessment: The seven annual trajectories interact strongly enough to support a single 2021 volume and form a coherent handoff into SP-2022-Y. No Evidence-backed need to split 2021 into H1/H2 was found.
